description: §7.6 (S479): writing `shared`, a file-scope `let` declared in lib.scrml, from app through a named import is E-FILE-SCOPE-LET-FOREIGN-WRITE (PERMANENT; the capable form is a function lib.scrml exports, §66.19).
rationale: §7.6: "A file-scope `let` is written only in the file that declares it (S479) … A write of it from another file — through a named import, an `as` alias or a namespace import (§21.3), and in any write form … — SHALL be a compile error, **`E-FILE-SCOPE-LET-FOREIGN-WRITE`**." ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S479 "⭐ RULED — #1962 file-scope questions 1–4 + `parseVariant` duplicate keys, PA recs adopted" item 3.
